newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE stocks rise on bank, insurance gains.
newsitem.headline: UAE stocks rise on bank, insurance gains.

text.p: Shares on the United Arab Emirates informal stock exchange ended the week to Thursday higher on the back of gains by bank and insurance shares, traders said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) index rose 8.95 points to 2,628.76 from 2,619.81.
Of the 27 shares traded on the market, five rose, one declined and the rest remained unchanged, traders said.
Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co closed at 1,150 dirhams from 1,130 dirhams while Al-Ain Al-Ahlia Insurance rose 10 dirhams to 970, traders said.
Emirates Bank International gained one dirham to 27 dirhams, while National Bank of Umm Al-Quwain rose five dirhams to 235 dirhams and the NBAD closed 10 dirhams higher at 565 dirhams.
Traders said Emaar Properties was traded one dirham lower at 19 dirhams. ($1=3.67 dirhams)
